breedingFormula: floor((parent1.combiRank + parent2.combiRank + 1) / 2), then the closest combiRank on the full roster (ties favor the lower rank). The site's own exclusive-pair exceptions (breedingOverrides) aren't scrapable from the current page markup, so the calculator always uses the formula now.

pals.description: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Lamball

pals.description: At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player’s max carrying capacity by 100. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Cattiva

pals.description: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Chikipi

pals.description: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they’ve killed their master after learning to use weapons.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, leaps onto the player’s head and uses a submachine gun to follow up the player’s attacks.
pals.name: Lifmunk

pals.description: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.
pals.name: Fuack

pals.description: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.
pals.name: Fuack Ignis

pals.description: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Vixy

pals.description: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey’s end.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.
pals.name: Celaray

pals.description: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celaray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.
pals.name: Celaray Lux

pals.description: Compared to Lamball, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Cremis

pals.description: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Croajiro channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While airborne, the player’s Attack is increased by 50%.
pals.name: Croajiro

pals.description: The Croajiro who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it’s your life that’s on the line.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Dark attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Croajiro Noct

pals.description: When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s Herbil’s approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to restore 30% of the player’s Max Health when incapacitated.
pals.name: Herbil

pals.description: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, restores 120% of the player’s Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation)
pals.name: Teafant

pals.description: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, improves logging efficiency by 30% and reduces weight of all types of wood by 40%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Gumoss

pals.description: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to “stay” is risky business, as the “go” command triggers that same attack instinct.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s melee weapon damage by 10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Pupperai

pals.description: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Clovee

pals.description: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electric explosion upon impact.
pals.name: Jolthog

pals.description: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker’s body.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact.
pals.name: Jolthog Cryst

pals.description: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by 100%. Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Depresso

pals.description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on impact and is incapacitated.
pals.name: Pengullet

pals.partnerSkill: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher to fire Pengullet Lux as ammunition. Pengullet Lux explodes on impact and is incapacitated.
pals.name: Pengullet Lux

pals.description: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it’s doing its best to strut arrogantly.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Fire Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Penking

pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Water attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Penking Lux

pals.description: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. “I think, therefore I am.”
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Dark Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Hoocrates

pals.description: Don’t be fooled by this Pal’s fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Kingpaca’s Defense and Movement Speed. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Melpaca

pals.description: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. This Pal’s Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5% for each Melpaca in party.
pals.name: Kingpaca

pals.description: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. This Pal’s Defense and Movement Speed increase by 5% for each Melpaca in party.
pals.name: Kingpaca Cryst

pals.description: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark magic bullets. These bullets will not reduce the target’s Health below 1.
pals.name: Daedream

pals.description: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.
pals.name: Tanzee

pals.description: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.
pals.name: Tanzee Ignis

pals.description: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, detects the location of nearby Pal Effigies.
pals.name: Nox

pals.description: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.1% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Flambelle

pals.description: Wild Rooby surprisingly never gets sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Defense of Fire Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Rooby

pals.description: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Mau

pals.description: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Mau Cryst

pals.description: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents’ strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases efficiency of destroying Stone by 500%.
pals.name: Rushoar

pals.description: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.
pals.name: Foxparks

pals.description: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air.
pals.name: Foxparks Cryst

pals.description: It wraps itself around an enemy’s head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.
pals.name: Killamari

pals.description: It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.
pals.name: Killamari Primo

pals.description: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, improves player mining efficiency by 30% and reduces Stone weight by 80%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Fuddler

pals.description: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by 220%.
pals.name: Eikthyrdeer

pals.description: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While at a base, increases the Lumbering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra

pals.description: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts.
pals.name: Direhowl

pals.description: The shrub on this Pal’s back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores 100 Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Caprity

pals.description: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to Ranch. While in party, restores 100 Pal’s Hunger to the Pal with the lowest Hunger every 5 minutes. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Caprity Noct

pals.description: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack and Defense of Sweepa.
pals.name: Swee

pals.description: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. This Pal’s Attack and Defense increase by 12% for each Swee in party.
pals.name: Sweepa

pals.description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it’s utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, reduces the weight of the item Ore by 80%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Turtacle

pals.description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, reduces weight of Sulfur and Coal by 80%. Also increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Ground attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Turtacle Terra

pals.partnerSkill: Wikily Servers
pals.name: Hangyu

pals.partnerSkill: Wikily Servers
pals.name: Hangyu Cryst

pals.description: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Woolipop

pals.description: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Woolipop Terra

pals.description: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It’s truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.
pals.partnerSkill: Sometimes drops Milk when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Mozzarina

pals.description: This Pal’s white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Water and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Azurobe

pals.description: This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Azurobe Cryst

pals.description: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Electric Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Sparkit

pals.description: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Water Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Kelpsea

pals.description: Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Fire Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Kelpsea Ignis

pals.description: A Pal that’s never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva’s pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Neutral Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) While at a base, increases the Handiwork Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Ribbuny

pals.description: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva’s pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Grass attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack) Increases Ribbuny Botan’s efficiency by 200% when working at a Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, or other related facilities.
pals.name: Ribbuny Botan

pals.description: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by 55%. While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette’s watering speed increases by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Jelliette

pals.description: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette. It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases items obtained from salvaging by 55%. While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jellroy’s watering speed increases by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Jellroy

pals.description: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Amione

pals.description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the capture gauge decreases 12% more slowly while the bars are not overlapping during the fishing minigame. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Gloopie

pals.description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Defense of Water Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Gloopie Primo

pals.description: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.
pals.name: Galeclaw

pals.description: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a back bonus. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Wispaw

pals.description: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount.
pals.name: Nitewing

pals.description: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap.
pals.name: Tombat

pals.description: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.
pals.name: Tocotoco

pals.description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Electric attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Univolt

pals.description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Univolt Cryst

pals.description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player’s Attack by 10%.
pals.name: Gobfin

pals.description: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player’s Attack by 10%.
pals.name: Gobfin Ignis

pals.description: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn’t hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player’s melee weapon attack speed by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Loupmoon

pals.description: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player’s melee weapon attack speed by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Loupmoon Cryst

pals.description: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, grants Night Vision to see in dark places. Activate again to turn off. Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Cawgnito

pals.description: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party,the player gains Cold Resistance +2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Arsox

pals.description: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Muffly

pals.description: This prickly Pal’s thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Grass Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Bristla

pals.description: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with . While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Cinnamoth

pals.description: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Puffolt

pals.description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, Dark Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Elphidran

pals.description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Elphidran Aqua

pals.description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 20%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Vanwyrm

pals.description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Vanwyrm Cryst

pals.description: Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings. It’s probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.
pals.partnerSkill: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealt as Health.
pals.name: Felbat

pals.description: The castle was filled with the king’s favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, “The King’s Flower.”
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Ground Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops various seeds when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Vaelet

pals.description: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Elizabee’s Attack. Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Beegarde

pals.description: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.
pals.partnerSkill: This Pal’s Attack increases by 12% for each Beegarde in party.
pals.name: Elizabee

pals.description: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.
pals.partnerSkill: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealt as Health.
pals.name: Lovander

pals.description: Grintale’s eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a 50% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Grintale

pals.description: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it’s resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its “personality.”
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider web to grapple and move at high speed.
pals.name: Tarantriss

pals.description: Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 80% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes.
pals.name: Polapup

pals.description: Among Polapup Terras, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 80% while mounted on snow. Can also slide quickly down slopes. While it starts out slow, the top speed it can hit while sliding is no joke.
pals.name: Polapup Terra

pals.description: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Leezpunk and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for seconds.
pals.name: Leezpunk

pals.description: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal’s owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Leezpunk Ignis and the player become invisible, making them undetectable to enemies for seconds.
pals.name: Leezpunk Ignis

pals.description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat’s Attack by 75% for a limited time.
pals.name: Gorirat

pals.description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat, if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s climbing speed by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Gorirat Terra

pals.description: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Surfent

pals.description: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, the player’s attacks increase Muddy buildup by 2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Surfent Terra

pals.description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s bow damage by 10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Robinquill

pals.description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s bow charge speed by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Robinquill Terra

pals.description: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.
pals.name: Flopie

pals.description: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Wixen changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 30%.
pals.name: Wixen

pals.description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Wixen Noct changes the player’s attack type to Dark and increases Attack by 30%.
pals.name: Wixen Noct

pals.description: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Neutral Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. Also has a 10% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Katress

pals.description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, increases the Kindling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Katress Ignis

pals.description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. Those who dies from Helzephyr’s lightning are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Dark and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Helzephyr

pals.description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there’s a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Helzephyr Lux

pals.description: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Elgrove changes the player’s attack type to Grass and increases Attack by 30%.
pals.name: Elgrove

pals.description: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, grants the player the ability to Freeze enemies afflicted with Soak in one strike.
pals.name: Elgrove Cryst

pals.description: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, spheres home in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by 300. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Lunaris

pals.description: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were often seen in works of art.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.
pals.name: Fenglope

pals.description: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While in party,Water Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Fenglope Lux

pals.description: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase “step on a Dinossom’s tail” has come to mean enraging someone.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increase Defense of Dragon Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Dinossom

pals.description: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase “struck by a Dinossom Lux’s bolt” has come to mean narrowly escaping death.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases Defense of Electric Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Dinossom Lux

pals.description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.
pals.name: Bushi

pals.description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. While in party, increases the player’s melee weapon damage by 30% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Bushi Noct

pals.description: The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans— whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, reduces the weight of ingredient and food by 30%. When paired with another Ice Pal, their Rot Speed also reduces by -30%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Munchill

pals.description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by 220% and mining efficiency by 500%.
pals.name: Mammorest

pals.description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, increases logging efficiency by 220% and mining efficiency by 500%.
pals.name: Mammorest Cryst

pals.description: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Finsider changes the player’s attack type to Water and increases Attack by 30%.
pals.name: Finsider

pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies, reducing the weight of weapons in your inventory by 60%. Also increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Fire attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Finsider Ignis

pals.description: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player’s Health by 75%. While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Petallia

pals.description: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player’s Health by 80%. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Grass damage, and are immune to Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Petallia Ignis

pals.description: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!
pals.partnerSkill: This Pal’s Attack and Defense increase by 2% for each other Grass Pal in your party.
pals.name: Leafan

pals.description: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn’t too hard to imagine.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.
pals.name: Incineram

pals.description: It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain. One can only imagine the profound despair of a parent whose child has been taken away.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.
pals.name: Incineram Noct

pals.description: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Electric bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target’s Health below 1.
pals.name: Dazzi

pals.description: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, appears near the player. Attacks hostile enemies with Dark bolts. These bolts will not reduce the target’s Health below 1.
pals.name: Dazzi Noct

pals.description: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Pyrin

pals.description: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type toDark and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Pyrin Noct

pals.description: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it’s quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.
pals.name: Relaxaurus

pals.description: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.
pals.name: Relaxaurus Lux

pals.description: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Ice Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Foxcicle

pals.description: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5%. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon)
pals.name: Beakon

pals.description: Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 5%. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Ice Pal in your party. (Excluding Beakon Cryst)
pals.name: Beakon Cryst

pals.description: With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler. No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Dark or Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Ghangler)
pals.name: Ghangler

pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Fire or Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Ghangler Ignis)
pals.name: Ghangler Ignis

pals.description: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. When two Rayhounds collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)
pals.name: Rayhound

pals.description: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Ice Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Rayhound Cryst

pals.description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, player’s Defense increases, and Electric Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Menasting

pals.description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, player’s Defense increases, and Electric Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Menasting Terra

pals.description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases player’s and Pals’ damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Needoll

pals.description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the player’s attacks increase Ivy-Covered buildup by 2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Needoll Noct

pals.description: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, the player gains Heat Resistance +2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Reindrix

pals.description: A Pal so powerful it’s hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It’s only by some miracle that this Pal isn’t a meat-eater.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.
pals.name: Mossanda

pals.description: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal’s been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.
pals.name: Mossanda Lux

pals.description: It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Dragon and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Chillet

pals.description: It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Chillet Ignis

pals.description: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Fire and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Ragnahawk

pals.description: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a mount. This Pal’s Attack increases by 4% for each other Fire or Ground Pal in your party.
pals.name: Moldron

pals.description: In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Ice attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Moldron Cryst

pals.description: Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 155% while mounted on grass.
pals.name: Palumba

pals.description: A Digtoise possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it, ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children’s tale, “Digtoise’s Fable”.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, enters the state. Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by 800%.
pals.name: Digtoise

pals.description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the “Fragrance of First Love.”
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a 35% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Broncherry

pals.description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the “Perfume of Purity.”
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, Pal Eggs you pick up have a 45% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Broncherry Aqua

pals.description: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn’t even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Attack of Ground Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Dumud

pals.description: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +100%. Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop Gold Coin. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Dumud Gild

pals.description: Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in your base, increases the egg production speed of Pals assigned to Breeding Farm by 20%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Braloha

pals.description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Ice damage and are immune to Freeze. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Kitsun

pals.description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun Noct is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Dark damage and are immune to Blind. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Kitsun Noct

pals.description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn’t realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, Grass Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Blazehowl

pals.description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn’t realize its prey gets cursed.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, Neutral Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Blazehowl Noct

pals.description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, generates a barrier around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within 5 seconds. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Warsect

pals.description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn’t flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, generates a barrier around the player after 5 melee hits are landed within 5 seconds. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Warsect Terra

pals.description: So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Frostplume’s icy aura sharpens focus, increasing the player’s reload speeds by 20%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Frostplume

pals.description: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it’s simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to 15% of the player’s attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)
pals.name: Majex

pals.description: A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier. Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Sibelyx

pals.description: A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Defense of Neutral Pals by 15%. (Does not stack) Sometimes makes High Quality Cloth when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Sibelyx Primo

pals.description: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, all Party Pals’ Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by 30% whenever you defeat an enemy. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Maraith

pals.description: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it’s not because it’s mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it’s high off its own spores.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops Mushroom or Cavern Mushroom when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Shroomer

pals.description: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it’s not because it’s mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don’t let it see anything.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by 10%.
pals.name: Shroomer Noct

pals.description: Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it’s going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Icelyn changes the player’s attack type to Ice and increases Attack by 30%.
pals.name: Icelyn

pals.description: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.
pals.partnerSkill: While fighting together, when Gildra is incapacitated, it revives with its Hunger reduced to 0.
pals.name: Gildra

pals.description: Legend says the Jormuntide was once a wise man who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, increases player’s and Pals’ damage to enemies afflicted with Soak by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Jormuntide

pals.description: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, nullifies lava damage and increases player’s and Pals’ damage to enemies afflicted with Burn by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Jormuntide Ignis

pals.description: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku)
pals.name: Suzaku

pals.description: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. Whenever there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Water Pal in your party. (Excluding Suzaku Aqua)
pals.name: Suzaku Aqua

pals.description: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Movement Speed is increased by 50% while mounted on sand.
pals.name: Dazemu

pals.description: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases Attack of Dragon Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Quivern

pals.description: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Grass and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Quivern Botan

pals.description: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie’s hay fever is Lullu’s fault.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, Lullu fills farms with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops by 50%.
pals.name: Lullu

pals.description: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikit’s themselves didn’t mind because it helped shed their old carapace.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Defense of Ground Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Kikit

pals.description: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While fighting together, 15% increased chance of encountering pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)
pals.name: Yakumo

pals.description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Skutlass becomes the player’s katana (Attack: 2600). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.
pals.name: Skutlass

pals.description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player’s katana (Attack: 2900). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.
pals.name: Skutlass Ignis

pals.description: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, the water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of all types of ore by 30%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Reptyro

pals.description: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of all types of ore by 35%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Reptyro Cryst

pals.description: It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can’t focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal’s movement speed increases by +50% at night.
pals.name: Starryon

pals.description: It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can’t focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Boosts Jump Power while mounted. This Pal’s Movement Speed increases by 5% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. (Excluding Starryon Primo)
pals.name: Starryon Primo

pals.description: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases player’s and Pals’ damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Pierdon

pals.description: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Dragon damage. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Pierdon Cryst

pals.description: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, Dragon Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Cryolinx

pals.description: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when attacking enemy weak point, increases the power of the next weak point attack by 30%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Cryolinx Terra

pals.description: “To look at a Snugloo’s eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Snugloo

pals.description: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While at a base, increases the Transporting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Wumpo

pals.description: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Ground damage and are immune to Muddy status. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Wumpo Botan

pals.description: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Neutral damage. (Does not stack) Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to Ranch.
pals.name: Sootseer

pals.description: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn’t change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals damage to enemies it touches (Grass / Power: 40). (Does not stack)
pals.name: Carnibora

pals.description: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 5% whenever you defeat an enemy. This effect lasts 20 seconds and stacks up to five times.
pals.name: Blazamut

pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases damage dealt by Player and Pals’ Dragon attacks when hitting the enemy’s elemental weakness by 25%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Blazamut Ryu

pals.description: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it’s impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, Dualith fires a powerful Grass laser from its right hand.
pals.name: Dualith

pals.description: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, Dualith Noct fires a powerful Dark laser from its right hand.
pals.name: Dualith Noct

pals.description: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Anubis changes the player’s attack type to Ground and increases Attack by 30%. Occasionally evades attacks with a flash sidestep during battle.
pals.name: Anubis

pals.description: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, boosts Anubis’s work speed by 20%. Increases efficiency by 30% if Sekhmet is working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Sekhmet

pals.description: It has about 5,000 types of venom. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases player’s and Pals’ damage to enemies afflicted with Poison by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Prixter

pals.description: It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Prixter Lux changes the player’s attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 30%.
pals.name: Prixter Lux

pals.description: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Tetroise

pals.description: Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces durability loss of all weapons and armor by 80%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Tetroise Primo

pals.description: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it’ll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time. While in party, increases the player’s shotgun damage by 10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Nyafia

pals.description: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for “being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death.”
pals.partnerSkill: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key. Does not apply to chests that require a specific Work Suitability.
pals.name: Mimog

pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the damage of the last bullet fired from a full-auto weapon by 100%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Xenovader

pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, increases the player’s energy weapon damage by 10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Xenogard

pals.description: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island’s nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, Prunelia’s prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest by 18%.
pals.name: Prunelia

pals.description: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one.
pals.partnerSkill: While fighting together, Pals drop +100% more Pal Souls when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Nitemary

pals.description: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Defense of Grass Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Nitemary Botan

pals.description: The black flames are merely warm to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, Chromite acquisition increases by +100%.
pals.name: Smokie

pals.description: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, increases the Cooling Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Smokie Cryst

pals.description: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it’s not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Party Pals’ EXP gained by 40%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Omascul

pals.description: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigames start with the capture gauge increased by 5%. Additionally, while the bars overlap, capture progress increases by 5%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Whalaska

pals.description: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, fishing minigame begins with the capture gauge 7% higher than usual, and capture progress increases by 7% while the bars overlap. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Whalaska Ignis

pals.description: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, grants 1 additional jump and 1 additional mid-air dash. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Verdash

pals.description: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases by 100%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Splatterina

pals.description: During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ground and increases Attack by 5%.
pals.name: Gildane

pals.description: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, teleports to the nearest base. Cannot be used inside dungeons or similar areas.
pals.name: Dogen

pals.description: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.
