pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Bulldosu

pals.description: Ancient texts refer to it as the “Beast of Salvation.” The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. This Pal’s Attack and Movement Speed increases by 2% for each other Neutral Pal in your party. When in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.15% per second. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Celesdir

pals.description: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, the Pal fighting alongside you gradually loses Health in exchange for 40% Attack increase. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Celesdir Noct

pals.description: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores by 1100%, and you can obtain 150% more Ore while mounted.
pals.name: Astegon

pals.description: Can be disassembled into 215 parts. It is capable of being reassembled and functioning again even if the parts are scattered. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a malfunction due to mistaken identity.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem’s Attack by 50% and Defense by 50% for a limited time.
pals.name: Knocklem

pals.description: Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem Ignis’s Attack by 60% and Defense by 60% for a limited time.
pals.name: Knocklem Ignis

pals.description: The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won’t come off easily.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces shield regeneration delay by 30% and reduces damage taken by your shield by 65%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Silvegis

pals.description: Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God’s true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Grants Air Dash, to move at even higher speeds.
pals.name: Azurmane

pals.description: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Valentail

pals.description: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the player’s attacks increase Electrify buildup by 2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Snock

pals.description: Tossing a heated Snock Terra into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Water damage, and are immune to Soak. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Snock Terra

pals.description: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Souffline

pals.description: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s Defense by 50% while sprinting. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Lapiron

pals.description: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it’s no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Hoodle

pals.description: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to 40% of the player’s attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)
pals.name: Slowatt

pals.description: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack by 40%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Bakemi

pals.description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Solmora

pals.description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Electric and increases Attack by 5%. While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Solmora Lux

pals.description: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals by 10%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Lapure

pals.description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Attack and Movement Speed increase by 2% for each other Dragon or Dark Pal in your party.
pals.name: Eidrolon

pals.description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Attack and Movement Speed increase by 2% for each other Dragon or Fire Pal in your party. (Excluding Eidrolon Ignis)
pals.name: Eidrolon Ignis

pals.description: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies’ brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs by 20%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Dynamoff

pals.description: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Tropicaw

pals.description: It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to 40% of the player’s attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)
pals.name: Flaracle

pals.description: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, the player’s attacks increase Soak buildup by 2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Ophydia

pals.description: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when the player’s Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player (Fire / Power: 777 / Burn buildup: 777). Additionally, while the player’s Health is below 50%, the player’s Attack is increased. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Dupin

pals.description: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player’s and Pals’ damage to enemies afflicted with Blind by 50%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Roujay

pals.description: Whenever it’s confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they’re all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the player’s attacks increase Blind buildup by 2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Venusa

pals.description: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.
pals.partnerSkill: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Mycora

pals.description: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the player’s arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to 15% of the player’s attack damage. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Loomen

pals.description: At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases Defense of Dark Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Wistella

pals.description: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, increases the player’s Attack by 30% if all Pals in party are different species. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Solenne

pals.description: At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, the player’s attacks increase Burn buildup by 2. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Renjishi

pals.description: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron’s wings was used to send simple flash signals.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While in party, player and party Pals take 60% less damage from explosive attacks, and are immune to Stun. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Aegidron

pals.description: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.
pals.name: Grizzbolt

pals.description: A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power to discipline naughty Pals.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, the queen’s soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by 80%.
pals.name: Lyleen

pals.description: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.
pals.partnerSkill: When activated, the queen’s soothing graces restore the Health of the player and Party Pals by 85%.
pals.name: Lyleen Noct

pals.description: It sends electricity into its foes’ wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 1% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack.)
pals.name: Orserk

pals.description: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Ice Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Faleris

pals.description: When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, Fire Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Faleris Aqua

pals.description: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, Movement Speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks by 15% while mounted.
pals.name: Shadowbeak

pals.description: The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, enhances Neutral and Dark attacks by 15%.
pals.name: Selyne

pals.description: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with a hammer forged from Ice.
pals.name: Bastigor

pals.description: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. This Pal’s Attack increases by 4% for each other Dragon Pal in your party.
pals.name: Shaolong

pals.partnerSkill: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Ivy-Covered, the enemy explodes, dealing additional damage equal to 40% of the player’s attack damage. (Does not stack) Also grants immunity to the World Tree’s Explosive Spores to both the player and their Pals.
pals.name: Silvance

pals.partnerSkill: When activated, the player’s attacks increase Poison buildup by 2. While in party, grants the player and party Pals immunity to Poison, and nullifies the effects of toxic gas in the World Tree area. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Dandilord

pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.
pals.name: Bellanoir

pals.partnerSkill: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with . When this Pal uses , it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.
pals.name: Bellanoir Libero

pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, damage done by Partner Skills of weapon-wielding Pals increases by 20%. (Does not stack)
pals.name: Xenolord

pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. While mounted, it generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted.
pals.name: Hartalis

pals.description: Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted. Activate to have Necromus stay by your side and attack enemies in tandem.
pals.name: Paladius

pals.description: Once one with Paladius. Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. When skill is activated, a Paladius in your party will appear and attack alongside you.
pals.name: Necromus

pals.description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Ice, increases Attack by 10%, and apply Freeze buildup by 2.
pals.name: Frostallion

pals.description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While mounted, changes the player’s attack type to Dark, increases Attack by 10%, and apply Blind buildup by 2.
pals.name: Frostallion Noct

pals.description: After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.
pals.partnerSkill: While in party, it follows up the player’s attacks with Water spear strikes. Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water.
pals.name: Neptilius

pals.description: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.
pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.
pals.name: Jetragon

pals.partnerSkill: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.
pals.name: Panthalus

pals.partnerSkill: This Pal’s abilities are still being investigated.
pals.name: Astralym
